source.title: Z1 M3 Vault-to-Code Gap Analysis priorities. P0 Structural changes: Genesis unlock (CW-03/M39) with 7 buckets, Provider recirculation rate, Full composite Settlement Ratio (SR) formula, and Epoch pipeline reordering (AR top-up before settlement). P1 Fidelity changes: Discrete VRP + CIP pools with waterfall priority, Governance staking as Z1U sink, Creator cohort with CIP distribution and recirculation, Validator cohort with VRP rewards, 4-stage PCS with epoch budget. P2 Completeness: Dormancy and churn tracking, ACR hold/void states, Vesting modes (cliff_then_linear, staggered), Formal sensitivity analysis.
